decision.reason: The explicit page-85 photograph captions identify the three bounded examples. The actual frozen meshes and vector icons retain their source-visible distinguishing forms while avoiding terminal counts, hidden connectors, inner damping layers and unseen mounting holes. The stated arbitrary proportions and plain closures are necessary limitations, not verified product construction.

sourceFeatures: Stepped pale rectangular housing and projecting front fascia
Five left status lamps and four channel lamps
Blank display area, three lower buttons and two vertically separated right buttons
perTypeFindings.modelAssessment: Actual front/oblique renders and code match those visible feature groups. Continuous terminal bands deliberately omit unverified screw/contact count. Display remains blank; no hidden rear mounting or ports are invented.
perTypeFindings.iconAssessment: Distinct relay silhouette with the same front feature groups; terminal bands remain abstract.

sourceFeatures: One slender metallic probe with a collar
Probe joined to loose coiled cable
Dark free-end sleeve and three visible free leads
perTypeFindings.modelAssessment: Actual mesh retains continuous probe-to-cable-to-sleeve connections and three lead ends. Cable turn count/spacing is presentation only. No threaded head, connector block or flange is invented.
perTypeFindings.iconAssessment: Distinct probe-and-coil silhouette with three free ends, limited to the photographed example rather than all PT100 sensor constructions.

sourceFeatures: Long projecting mounting flange with one visible near hole
Broad concave/depressed upper seat and inset surface
perTypeFindings.modelAssessment: Actual oblique mesh shows the concave seat. The near mounting hole is a real opening, independently checked by the focused raycast test. No far hole, wheel, spring, rubber cross-section or hidden fastener is added.
perTypeFindings.iconAssessment: Distinct concave support/flange silhouette with one near-hole mark, without manufacturing-radius or internal-layer claims.

visibleLimitations.common: Иллюстративная внешняя форма по фото на стр. 85; не CAD, не размеры и не все исполнения изделия. Скрытые поверхности условные.
visibleLimitations.relay: Задняя сторона показана условно; число и назначение клемм не установлены. Дисплей — неподвижная иллюстрация.
visibleLimitations.probe: Показан датчик с кабелем из каталога, а не все исполнения pt-100. Число витков и положение кабеля условны; длина и назначение жил не заданы.
visibleLimitations.damper: Показано только видимое на фото монтажное отверстие. Кривизна седла условная; скрытые слои и крепления не восстановлены.

forbiddenClaims: Exact CAD, manufacturing dimensions, measured cable length or seat radius
Universal mechanical form for every PT100 sensor
TR-100 terminal count, rear ports or DIN mounting established by this photograph
Every EK-290 hole, fastener or hidden damping/material layer has been modelled
Automatic geometry/icon authority for any ID beyond the three pinned records
